## Install

**Easiest: paste this into Terminal** (Applications → Utilities → Terminal)

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niche-browser/niche/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

It puts Niche in your Applications folder and opens it, with no security prompts. From then on Niche keeps itself up to date.

**Or download `Niche.dmg` below**

1. Open `Niche.dmg` and drag Niche to Applications.
2. Open Niche. macOS says it could not verify the app. Click **Done**.
3. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to "Niche was blocked".
4. Confirm with Touch ID or your password, then click **Open Anyway** once more.

You only do this once. Niche is an early, independent open-source project and is not notarized by Apple yet; every line of it is in this repository.
